title: routing conformance probe and progressive adapter for legacy rule shapes
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a non-invasive conformance probe and a progressive adapter that validates incoming routing config DSLs (region selection, tier routing, fallback model variants) and allows safe incremental migration from legacy rule shapes. The probe will run in a read-only mode by default, emit canonicalized policy artifacts, and provide deterministic mismatch reports with remediation hints for the Console and CI gate. Deliverables: (1) a policy conformance harness service that accepts a rule blob and returns canonicalized IR + violation list, (2) an adapter layer that can be enabled cluster-side to translate known legacy fields into the new canonical schema with opt-out, (3) an integration test suite (fuzz + deterministic cases) covering region/tier/fallback combinatorics, and (4) a migration playbook for customers and internal rollout owners.
acceptance_criteria: Harness accepts existing rule blobs and returns canonicalized IR for 95% of current production shapes without mutation when run in read-only mode
Adapter translates legacy 'region_hint' and 'preferred_tiers' into canonical selectors with a documented mapping and feature-flag toggle
Fuzz test suite detects and classifies mismatches into: syntax, schema, semantic (ambiguous fallback), and unsupported-variant categories
Console shows a clear remediation link with suggested minimal edit for each reported mismatch
Canary rollout plan defined that stages the adapter across regions and includes SLO regression checks (latency 99th + error rate)
progress_updates: 2026-02-11: Spike completed on canonical IR shape. Chose a compact tuple representation for (region, tier, variant) to keep policy keys stable across versions.
2026-02-18: Prototype harness implemented as a small HTTP service (policy-probe) that returns canonicalization diffs. Initial prototype lives in internal repo rwd/policy-probe (WIP).
2026-02-25: Fuzz harness added using libfuzzer-style random rule generation; found 27 ambiguous fallback cases in current production samples — recorded as classification examples.
2026-03-02: Design review with PM/Console team. Agreed on exposing remediation hints as a minimal JSON patch and a human-readable suggestion string for Console UI.
2026-03-07: Security review request filed; pending input about exposing canonicalized IR in logs. Marked for encryption-at-rest in internal design doc.
2026-03-11: Integration test matrix created that enumerates 3 region affinity patterns x 4 tier placement policies x 6 fallback variants = 72 deterministic scenarios. Running in CI smoke suite.
2026-03-12: Began implementing adapter feature-flag and server-side toggle. First canary planned for non-prod infra in eu-west-1.
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Prefer non-mutating read-only probe by default to avoid accidental regressions for existing customers
Adapter will be opt-in behind a feature flag instead of automatic migration to give customers control over rollout
Canonical IR is intentionally conservative: we model ambiguous fallbacks explicitly rather than implicitly resolving them to avoid behavioral drift
We will emit remediation hints rather than applying auto-fixes in the adapter to minimize surprising behavior; auto-fix is considered for an opt-in future release
testing_and_metrics: Added deterministic test harness covering 72 scenario matrix and 1k fuzz-generated inputs per PR run
Telemetry: probe reports per-shape classification counts and top-10 violation examples. We will track 'mismatch rate' and 'ambiguous-fallback rate' during canary
SLO checks: measure 99th percentile request latency for policy resolution path; must not increase by more than 5ms in canary compared to baseline
review_feedback: PM (R. Alvarez): emphasize UI workflows for remediation discovery; add quick links to the PRD and migration playbook
Security (L. Gomez): require canonical IR outputs to be treated as sensitive; restrict probe endpoint access and encrypt logs
Runtime team (H. Singh): adapter must not add per-request allocations in hot path; prefer cached canonicalization results with TTL
Observability (K. Brown): add tracing spans and standardized tags (policy.id, tenant.id, probe.version) to correlate mismatches with incidents
next_steps: Finish adapter toggle implementation and add TTL-backed cache for canonicalization results
Wire probe telemetry to Console diagnostics dashboard and expose remediation links in rule editor
Run a staged canary in eu-west-1 with synthetic traffic and monitor mismatch rate + SLO regressions for 48 hours
Document migration playbook and produce a short runbook for Solutions Engineering to onboard customers
